snippet.title: HOVERDRIVE Alpha Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist HOVERDRIVE on Steam now! store.steampowered.com/app/3074590/HOVERDRIVE

Jump, Boost, Drift, and HOVERDRIVE through gravity-defying levels in this vehicular platformer! Perform sick tricks to refill your boost and score a high style rating! Reach The Core at the end to complete each level, but beware of The Core's defenses...
